Today, the Supreme Court upheld Tennessee's law, confirming that states can ban life-altering transgender treatments for children —and they should. This is a historic victory for everyone who has fought to protect our kids from irreversible medical procedures.

This MASSIVE win paves the way for other states to enact similar protections. Thank you to @AGTennessee and everyone who worked tirelessly for this outcome. We’re committed to protecting children across America.

The One, Big, Beautiful Bill gives a $4,000 tax break to everyone 65+, saving retired couples up to $1,650 on their federal taxes. This relief helps pay for essentials—like housing, care, and medication—and gives seniors the retirement they’ve earned.

Healthcare costs are crushing Tennessee families. The One, Big, Beautiful Bill includes price transparency requirements so patients know what they're paying before treatment.

Tennessee's seniors built this country and deserve dignity in retirement. The One, Big, Beautiful Bill protects Social Security and Medicare from cuts.
